howToApply: Visit the APSC Recruitment website at https://apscrecruitment.in.
If not registered, click on ‘Register Here’ and complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) process.
Register with a valid and active e-mail address and mobile number.
Log in using registered e-mail/mobile number and password.
Fill in the required registration details as asked in the form.
Carefully read the eligibility criteria and other relevant details before applying.
Upload required documents/certificates (Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, caste/category etc.) in PDF format (max 4 MB, 200 dpi greyscale).
Upload recent Photograph (50 KB – 200 KB, not older than 3 months) and Signature (50 KB – 200 KB).
Fill all details carefully and tick the declaration checkbox to enable the Preview option.
Preview the application to confirm all documents are clear and legible.
Click ‘Proceed to Pay’ to pay the prescribed fee/charges.
Upon successful submission, an auto-generated confirmation e-mail/SMS will be sent to the registered e-mail ID/Mobile No.
Take a print-out of the submitted Online Application Form and retain the hard copy for future reference.
Candidates without debit card/Internet banking facilities may visit the nearest Common Service Center (CSC).
